notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
The direction key/shift key recognition no longer breaks when moving the map.
Fixed a bug where selection was not possible when proceeding with the spider puzzle.
A resolution setting has been added, so you can now play in environments other than 1920x1080 resolution.
Fixed a save/load bug in the village house puzzle.
